jina: Duty to abide by the laws of the land
maudhui: (1) Every person has the duty to observe and to abide by this Constitution and the laws of the United Republic. (2) Every person has the right, in accordance with the procedure provided by law, to take legal action to ensure the protection of this Constitution and the laws of the land.
vifungu: (1) Every person has the duty to observe and to abide by this Constitution and the laws of the United Republic.
(2) Every person has the right, in accordance with the procedure provided by law, to take legal action to ensure the protection of this Constitution and the laws of the land.
